title: Lab - Rolling updates and rollbacks
description: Drive a rollout, break it, and recover.
scenario: Drive a rollout, break it, and recover. This lab is a skeleton: the tasks name what to do and how to check it; work them on your own cluster and expand your notes as you go.
environment_setup:
# A three-node kind cluster is enough for this lab
cat <<'EOF' > kind-cka.yaml
kind: Cluster
apiVersion: kind.x-k8s.io/v1alpha4
name: cka
nodes:
  - role: control-plane
  - role: worker
  - role: worker
EOF
kind create cluster --config kind-cka.yaml
kubectl get nodes
cleanup:
kind delete cluster --name cka
rm -f kind-cka.yaml

tasks.title: Task 1 - Strategy
tasks.instructions: What strategy does Deployment frontend use, and what is its maxUnavailable?

tasks.title: Task 2 - Upgrade
tasks.instructions: Change the image to kodekloud/webapp-color:v2 and record the rollout.
tasks.solution:
kubectl set image deploy/frontend simple-webapp=kodekloud/webapp-color:v2
kubectl rollout status deploy/frontend

tasks.title: Task 3 - Break and undo
tasks.instructions: Set the image to a tag that does not exist, watch the rollout stall, then undo.
tasks.solution:
kubectl set image deploy/frontend simple-webapp=kodekloud/webapp-color:v99
kubectl rollout undo deploy/frontend
tasks.verification: kubectl get pods  # all Running again
